skill.name: mp-groundline
compatibility: system vince-mp CLI (for the verify step only)

change.summary_zh: 0.2.3 记录补丁（无行为改动，脚本与 0.2.2 相同）：记下第三轮修复（owner 2026-09-25 授权「这七个你都继续去做把他们做完」）的独立修复审计与发布检查结果。0.2.2 修掉了 OD1（packOptions.ignore 文件夹里的已声明页面照常扫描，不再静默漏报 rewrite）、OD2（默认布局提示只指向在 Skyline 上跑过的页面）以及 P3 的 OD3/OD5/OD6/OD7/OD8/OD9。审计无 P0/P1，留下 3 条 P3（OD1 放行整个文件夹、OD5 用例喂了 0.1.x 不产出的形状、gen_migration_map.mjs:160 的 OD2 残留），发布检查 release_ok:true；OD4 是 0.1.x 就有的已知限制。
change.summary_en: 0.2.3 record-only patch (no behaviour change; scripts identical to 0.2.2): records the independent fix audit and release check of the owner-authorized third fix round (2026-09-25). 0.2.2 fixed OD1 (a declared page inside a packOptions.ignore folder is scanned; no silent rewrite drop), OD2 (default-layout advice scoped to the pages that ran on Skyline) and P3s OD3/OD5/OD6/OD7/OD8/OD9. The audit found no P0/P1 and left 3 P3s (folder-wide OD1 un-skip, OD5 case fed a shape 0.1.x never emits, an OD2 residual at gen_migration_map.mjs:160); release check release_ok:true. OD4 is a known limit already present in 0.1.x.

gate_conditions: validate-skill green (scripts/validate-skill.mjs, local-only) on the dev checkout AND re-run on each install root after every deploy
deterministic eval harness green (node evals/run_all.mjs -> exit 0, 55/55; includes the generator structure/injection cases and the R3 regression cases)
E11 with/without two-arm evidence (A44) recorded in assets/metric-plan.json
waived_check_ids: real-program-smoke: scan-only smoke done 2026-09-25 on both deep-scan programs and wxa.cli.im; a DevTools before/after run was not possible offline (the earlier 'program no longer on disk' waiver was false)
trigger-eval: never run since 0.1.0; description unchanged through 0.2.2 (waived, open for the next K2 review)
adversarial-checklist-16/16: 0.1.0 build-time evidence, superseded by the 49-case harness and the R20 battery; not re-run

known-limit-OD4: a wx:// route on the same JS line after a quote-bearing regex literal is missed (documented in references/scanner-contract.md; present in installed 0.1.1 too, so not a regression; a fix needs regex-literal parsing)
carried-P3s F09 F12 F13 F15 F16 F17(remainder) F04r: battery round-1 P3s, all present in 0.1.1; not fixed in this wave (see CHANGELOG)

r3-audit-P3-a (scan.mjs ~416): the OD1 un-skip removes the WHOLE packOptions.ignore folder from the skip set once it holds one declared page, so undeclared, non-shipping subfolders yield rewrite findings and drop off the map's 'Not scanned' line (repro: ignore 'modules', declared modules/help/index, undeclared modules/_backup_skyline_demo with <grid-view/><sticky-header/>: 0.2.1 rewrite 0, 0.2.2 rewrite 2, installed 0.1.1 rewrite 2; re-run by the finalizer). Regression against 0.2.1 only; errs toward manual review, never a silent drop; waived by the release check. Narrower fix (un-skip only the declared page's directory chain) deferred under iron rule 3

r3-audit-P3-b (evals/cases.mjs ~1234): the OD5 case gen_legacy_scan_needs_flip_fallback feeds a scan shape 0.1.x never emits. On the real 0.1.x per-page shape (already_migrated:true plus a skyline pin) the 0.2.x generator prints STOP and a flip list in one map (reproduced by the finalizer). Only when an old scan meets the new generator; installed 0.1.1 prints the same STOP

r3-audit-P3-c (gen_migration_map.mjs:160, OD2 residual): the auditor's claim text was truncated before it reached the finalizer and is NOT reconstructed here; the conductor holds the full text. Finalizer's own probe on that line (not the audit claim): the per-page branch reads only app.json rendererOptions flags, so a pinned page whose own json sets both flags is still told to expect a layout shift

rollback.known_good_version: 0.1.1 (the installed release; carries the F01/F02 P1 misses fixed in 0.2.0)
rollback_trigger: false rewrite on a clean program
rollback.migration_target_rollback: the SKILL's own migration edits a git working tree: revert = git checkout app.json + touched page json
